svg.title: Lesson 52 lab walkthrough
svg.desc: Run a free baseline comparison, inspect nine rows, calibrate forty decisions, change candidates, review a retained digest, and promote only an eligible scoped baseline.

g.text: 1 Free baseline → 9 authored rows · 24 metric rows · 0 model calls
3 Cold tone / false refund → inspect fail and hard money gate
4 Retain → eligibility → reviewed digest → scoped baseline write
Optional paid trials require fresh consent and a compatible measured baseline.
